select
    plan,
    count(monthly_fee) as monthly_fee_count,
    count(case when plan = 'standard' then 1 end) as standard_count,
    round(stddev(monthly_fee), 2) as stddev_monthly_fee
from subscriptions
where plan = 'basic' and start_date < '2023-12-01'
group by plan
having sum(monthly_fee) >= 1190
order by stddev_monthly_fee desc;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter((F.col("plan") == "basic") & (F.col("start_date") < "2023-12-01"))
    .groupBy("plan")
    .agg(
        F.count("monthly_fee").alias("monthly_fee_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("plan") == "standard", 1)).alias("standard_count"),
        F.round(F.stddev("monthly_fee"), 2).alias("stddev_monthly_fee"),
        F.sum("monthly_fee").alias("total_monthly_fee"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("total_monthly_fee") >= 1190)
    .drop("total_monthly_fee")
    .orderBy(F.col("stddev_monthly_fee").desc())
)

SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(paid_at) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(paid_at) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS paid_cohort, ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payments
WHERE order_id IS NULL AND status IN ('REFUNDED', 'FAILED')
GROUP BY paid_cohort
ORDER BY paid_cohort DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNull() & F.col("status").isin(["REFUNDED", "FAILED"]))

    .orderBy(F.col("paid_cohort").desc())
)

SELECT a.account_type, SUM(CASE WHEN t.txn_type = 'DEBIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS debit_count
FROM transactions t
INNER JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.id
INNER JOIN customers c ON a.customer_id = c.id
WHERE c.country IN ('SG', 'TH')
GROUP BY a.account_type
ORDER BY a.account_type DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_transactions.alias("t")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("a"), F.col("t.account_id") == F.col("a.id"), "inner")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("c.country").isin(["SG", "TH"]))
    .groupBy(F.col("a.account_type"))
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("t.txn_type") == "DEBIT", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("debit_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("account_type").desc())
)

with filtered_products as (

sql:
WITH filtered_web_events AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM web_events
    WHERE duration_sec != 463
),
Summary AS (
    SELECT page, AVG(duration_sec) AS avg_duration_sec, SUM(CASE WHEN page = '/product' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS product_count
    FROM filtered_web_events
    GROUP BY page
)
SELECT page, avg_duration_sec, product_count
FROM Summary
WHERE avg_duration_sec > 160
ORDER BY product_count ASC, avg_duration_sec DESC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered_web_events = df_web_events.filter(F.col("duration_sec") != 463)

summary = (
    filtered_web_events
    .groupBy("page")
    .agg(
        F.avg("duration_sec").alias("avg_duration_sec"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("page") == "/product", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("product_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .filter(F.col("avg_duration_sec") > 160)
    .select("page", "avg_duration_sec", "product_count")
    .orderBy("product_count", F.col("avg_duration_sec").desc())
)

sql: WITH base AS (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount < 1200), agg AS (SELECT channel, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(status))) status_values, SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) web_amount FROM base GROUP BY channel) SELECT * FROM agg WHERE web_amount < 44 ORDER BY web_amount DESC;

sql:
WITH account_summary AS (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN merchant = 'Amazon' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS amazon_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT amount) AS unique_txn_types
    FROM transactions
    WHERE txn_type = 'CREDIT'
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    accounts.customer_id,
    accounts.status,
    account_summary.amazon_amount,
    account_summary.unique_txn_types
FROM accounts
LEFT OUTER JOIN account_summary ON accounts.id = account_summary.account_id
ORDER BY 3 ASC
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

account_summary = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("txn_type") == "CREDIT")
    .groupBy("account_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("merchant") == "Amazon", F.col("amount")).otherwise(0)).alias("amazon_amount"),
        F.countDistinct("amount").alias("unique_txn_types"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_accounts.alias("accounts")
    .join(account_summary.alias("account_summary"), F.col("accounts.id") == F.col("account_summary.account_id"), "left")
    .select(
        F.col("accounts.customer_id"),
        F.col("accounts.status"),
        F.col("account_summary.amazon_amount"),
        F.col("account_summary.unique_txn_types"),
    )
    .orderBy("amazon_amount")
)

WITH supplier_totals AS (
    SELECT supplier_id, SUM(CASE WHEN brand = 'Acme' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acme_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'Home' THEN 1 END) AS home_count
    FROM products
    WHERE stock_qty > 158
    GROUP BY supplier_id
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.country,
    st.acme_count,
    st.home_count
FROM suppliers s
LEFT JOIN supplier_totals st ON s.id = st.supplier_id
ORDER BY country DESC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

supplier_totals = (
    df_products
    .filter(F.col("stock_qty") > 158)
    .groupBy("supplier_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("brand") == "Acme", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("acme_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("category") == "Home", 1)).alias("home_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    df_suppliers.alias("s")
    .join(supplier_totals.alias("st"), F.col("s.id") == F.col("st.supplier_id"), "left")
    .select(
        F.col("s.id"),
        F.col("s.country"),
        F.col("st.acme_count"),
        F.col("st.home_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("country").desc())
)

sql: with order_stats as (select order_id, count(case when method = 'card' then 1 end) as card_count from payments where order_id = 34 group by order_id) select orders.amount, orders.channel, order_stats.card_count from orders left join order_stats on orders.id = order_stats.order_id where order_stats.card_count > 6 order by channel desc;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

order_stats = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("order_id") == 34)
    .groupBy("order_id")
    .agg(F.count(F.when(F.col("method") == "card", 1)).alias("card_count"))
)

result = (
    df_orders.alias("orders")
    .join(order_stats.alias("order_stats"), F.col("orders.id") == F.col("order_stats.order_id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("order_stats.card_count") > 6)
    .select(
        F.col("orders.amount"),
        F.col("orders.channel"),
        F.col("order_stats.card_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("channel").desc())
)

sql: SELECT country, CASE WHEN rating >= 3.8 THEN 'high' WHEN rating >= 1.7 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END AS rating_bucket, city, CONCAT_WS(', ', SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(country))) AS country_values, MAX(rating) - MIN(rating) AS rating_range FROM suppliers WHERE country <> 'SG' GROUP BY country, rating_bucket, city;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("country") != "SG")
    .groupBy(
        "country",
        F.when(F.col("rating") >= 3.8, "high").when(F.col("rating") >= 1.7, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("rating_bucket"),
        "city",
    )
    .agg(
        F.concat_ws(", ", F.sort_array(F.collect_set("country"))).alias("country_values"),
        (F.max("rating") - F.min("rating")).alias("rating_range"),
    )
)

sql: SELECT ss.product_id, ss.store_id, MIN(i.last_restock) AS first_last_restock, COUNT(DISTINCT i.quantity) AS unique_stores FROM inventory i INNER JOIN store_sales ss ON i.store_id = ss.store_id AND i.product_id = ss.product_id WHERE i.last_restock > '2023-03-12' GROUP BY ss.product_id, ss.store_id;

sql: SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(shipped_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(shipped_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END AS shipped_cohort, status, SUM(CASE WHEN carrier = 'FedEx' THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS fedex_cost, SUM(CASE WHEN carrier = 'Flash' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flash_count, MAX(shipped_date) AS latest_shipped_date FROM shipments WHERE (cost < 65 AND delivered_date > '2023-12-23') OR shipped_date <= '2024-06-01' GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(shipped_date) < 2024 THEN 'before_2024' WHEN YEAR(shipped_date) = 2024 THEN '2024' ELSE 'after_2024' END, status HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN carrier = 'Flash' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 76 ORDER BY latest_shipped_date, shipped_cohort, status LIMIT 20

)

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM payments
    WHERE amount >= 1460 AND (amount > 1420 OR status = 'REFUNDED')
),
summary AS (
    SELECT status, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS failed_count, SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(method)) AS method_list
    FROM base
    GROUP BY status
)
SELECT status, failed_count, method_list
FROM summary
WHERE failed_count >= 9
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_payments
    .filter((F.col("amount") >= 1460) & ((F.col("amount") > 1420) | (F.col("status") == "REFUNDED")))
)

summary = (
    base
    .groupBy("status")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "FAILED", 1)).alias("failed_count"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("method")).alias("method_list"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .filter(F.col("failed_count") >= 9)
    .select("status", "failed_count", "method_list")
)

sql: WITH recent_payments AS (SELECT * FROM payments WHERE method IS NOT NULL AND amount BETWEEN 870 AND 1500 AND method != 'bank_transfer'), PaymentsStats AS (SELECT status, ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount FROM recent_payments GROUP BY status) SELECT status, avg_amount FROM PaymentsStats WHERE avg_amount > 66 ORDER BY status DESC LIMIT 10;
code:

sql:
WITH FilteredOrders AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PENDING') THEN 'Tier 1' ELSE 'Other' END AS status_group
    FROM orders
    WHERE discount <= 0.35 OR store_id IN (24, 39)
),
summary AS (
    SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM FilteredOrders
    GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT channel, total_count
FROM summary
WHERE total_count < 8
ORDER BY total_count;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

filtered_orders = (
    df_orders
    .filter((F.col("discount") <= 0.35) | F.col("store_id").isin([24, 39]))
    .withColumn("status_group", F.when(F.col("status").isin(["COMPLETED", "PENDING"]), "Tier 1").otherwise("Other"))
)

summary = (
    filtered_orders
    .groupBy("channel")
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("total_count"))
)

result = (
    summary
    .filter(F.col("total_count") < 8)
    .select("channel", "total_count")
    .orderBy("total_count")
)

sql:
SELECT discount_bucket, avg_shipping_fee, shipped_discount
FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN discount >= 0.44 THEN 'high' WHEN discount >= 0.17 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END discount_bucket, AVG(shipping_fee) avg_shipping_fee, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SHIPPED' THEN discount ELSE 0 END) shipped_discount
    FROM orders
    WHERE store_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN discount >= 0.44 THEN 'high' WHEN discount >= 0.17 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'low' END
) t
WHERE shipped_discount < 41
ORDER BY shipped_discount ASC;
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("store_id").isNull())
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("discount") >= 0.44, "high").when(F.col("discount") >= 0.17, "mid").otherwise("low").alias("discount_bucket"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg("shipping_fee").alias("avg_shipping_fee"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "SHIPPED", F.col("discount")).otherwise(0)).alias("shipped_discount"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("shipped_discount") < 41)
    .select("discount_bucket", "avg_shipping_fee", "shipped_discount")
    .orderBy("shipped_discount")
)

SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', launch_date) AS launch_month, MIN(launch_date) AS min_launch_date, COUNT(CASE WHEN brand = 'Acme' THEN 1 END) AS acme_count

sql: select account_type, case when status in ('OPEN', 'FROZEN') then 'core' else 'other' end as status_group, sum(case when status = 'OPEN' then 1 else 0 end) as open_count, count(*) as account_count from accounts where (balance < 64000 and account_type = 'CHECKING') or opened_date < '2025-08-31' group by 1, 2
code:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_accounts
    .filter(((F.col("balance") < 64000) & (F.col("account_type") == "CHECKING")) | (F.col("opened_date") < "2025-08-31"))
    .groupBy(
        "account_type",
        F.when(F.col("status").isin(["OPEN", "FROZEN"]), "core").otherwise("other").alias("status_group"),

        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "OPEN", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("open_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("account_count"),
    )
)
